lines.text: At the end of a busy week, the hardest question can be the simplest: what is worth changing?
Start with what was observed. Choose five consecutive completed calendar days. Each one must pass its checks before the review can begin.
Behind that moment is a quiet trail in daily Markdown, including app and window context, typing and hotkeys, clicks, and clipboard changes.
The files are sensitive plaintext. Configured secure apps, secure fields, and manual pause make capture step back. There are no screenshots, audio, or video.
ActivityLogger prepares the review files. You review and redact them. Then you choose a trusted tool to look for repeated work, friction, and possible errors.
A careful review can link each possible pattern to its day and context. Work spans are not exact time records. Gaps stay unknown.
Your chosen review tool can suggest. It cannot decide. You may try one small idea, record a result in ActivityLogger, or choose no action.
Patterns may emerge. You decide what they mean.
